paragraphs: Markets over the last day: the eight tracked equity indices moved -0.94% on average, with Hang Seng strongest (+0.58%) and Nasdaq weakest (-2.60%). Brent crude changed +0.78% to 114.05. Gold changed -1.05% to 4,017.8999. Bitcoin changed -2.96% to 81,521.3672. The US 10-year yield stands at 4.953%, a relative move of -3.75%. Among the firms tracked, Blackstone (+8.38%) and Freeport-McMoRan (-6.26%) moved the most.
